Resolves #20593

Every `curve: 'throw'` stroke in [`GestureDriver#executeGridDragScrollStep`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/139ec1d6a3/apps/workstation/tour/GestureDriver.mjs) previously scheduled its `mouseup` sample with `delay: moveDelay` (`33 ms`), used a pure `ratio ** 4` curve across all `moveSteps`, and paced every whip sample at the full `33 ms` `moveDelay`. On the 2-vCPU GitHub Actions runner in `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` (`moveSteps: 24`, `deltaY: -480`), two failure modes combined:
1. Waiting `moveDelay` (`33 ms`) plus cursor-dot IPC before dispatching `mouseup` let the earlier `mousemove` samples age past [`GridDragScroll#onDragEnd`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/139ec1d6a3/src/main/addon/GridDragScroll.mjs)'s `now - 100` ms cutoff, or left only the final sample inside the window (`relevantMoves.length < 2`), so no momentum fired (`observed === requested`).
2. Even when the final two samples (`23 -> 24`) stayed inside the `100 ms` window — measured in hosted [`job 128832852382`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42513965598/job/128832852382) on `1494993db1` (`agesMs: [98, 9]`, `spanMs: 89`, `windowMoves: 2`) — a pure `ratio ** 4` curve spent `84.34%` (`(23/24) ** 4 = 405 px`) of the `-480 px` stroke before step 23, leaving only `75 px` (`15.66%`) for the final step (`23 -> 24`). Over that `89 ms` runner stall, `vY = (-75 / 80) * 16 = -15 px/frame` produced only `300 px` of momentum (`observed.y = 780 < 960`).

This PR:
1. Dispatches a `'throw'` stroke's `mouseup` sample at `delay: 0`, blends a 65% quartic wind-up with a 35% late whip (`0.65 * ratio ** 4 + 0.35 * ratio ** Math.max(4, moveSteps)` — identical to `ratio ** 4` at `moveSteps: 4`, while at `moveSteps: 24` keeping a visible wind-up with only 8 samples under 5 px through 264 ms, `20 px` at mid-stroke `k = 12`, `62 px` at `k = 16`, `153 px` at `k = 20`, and `156 px` / `32.5%` on the final step `23 -> 24` so an `89 ms` two-sample stall yields `vY = -28.0 px/frame` → `551 px` momentum → `observed.y = 1031 >= 960`), and tightens the final two whip `mousemove` delays to `Math.min(moveDelay, 8)`.
2. Records `proof.release` (`{agesMs, spanMs, windowMoves}`) on `executeGridDragScrollStep`'s receipt, logs `release` in the `[film-probe] close:` line in `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs`, and asserts `windowMoves >= 2`.
3. Restores `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` from `EXCLUSIONS` back into `RUN_PATHS` in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`, records `177.8` in `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json`, and updates `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`.

Evidence: L2 (automated E2E + unit test) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).
